headline.purpose: The one large heading per screen (h1) — this system has no larger display tier above it.

title.purpose: Card and section headers (h2/h3) — distinguished from body by weight, not size.

body.purpose: Default prose; .lead variant is the same size at 65% ink opacity for intro paragraphs.

label.purpose: Step indicators and section eyebrows (.micro) — always uppercase JetBrains Mono.

shadows.name: overlay-dropdown
shadows.purpose: Account menu popover — floats above the page, never used on an in-flow surface.

shadows.name: overlay-sticky-cta
shadows.purpose: Mobile sticky action bar — the only other overlay shadow in the system.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Shared focus-visible ring on buttons and inputs — the accent's third and last sanctioned appearance.

motion.name: checklist-pop
motion.purpose: Overshoot pop when a checklist item flips from pending to done — the system's one deliberate motion moment.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default transition speed for hover/focus/active state changes across buttons, inputs, and nav.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action — ink fill, flips to Seal Blue on hover (the accent's one sanctioned button appearance).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Onest', sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 700; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); background: var(--ink); color: #fff; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 9px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1f1fe6; border-color: #1f1fe6; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(31,31,230,.08); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default (unstyled) button variant — white fill, bordered, used for non-primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Onest', sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 700; border: 1.5px solid var(--crease, #dcd6cc); background: #fff; color: var(--ink); padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 9px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(17,17,16,.4); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action — back-links and secondary in-flow actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Onest', sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 700; border: 0; background: none; color: rgba(17,17,16,.7); padding: 12px 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content container — the brightest layer in the tonal stack, border not shadow.
components.html:
Пакет документов готов
5 документов под ваш сайт, обновляем сами при смене закона.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dcd6cc; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 18px; font-family: 'Onest', sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: #111110; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(17,17,16,.6); line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field — Seal Blue border + focus ring on focus, the accent's second sanctioned appearance.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: 'Onest', sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #111110; margin-bottom: 5px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1.5px solid #dcd6cc; border-radius: 9px; padding: 11px 13px; background: #fff; font-size: 15px; color: #111110; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #1f1fe6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(31,31,230,.08); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Small pill status token — semantic tint background, never a solid semantic fill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e8e4dd; color: rgba(17,17,16,.6); } .ds-chip-green { background: rgba(26,122,82,.10); color: #1a7a52; } .ds-chip-red { background: rgba(214,56,22,.10); color: #d63816; } .ds-chip-amber { background: rgba(184,121,0,.12); color: #b87900; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Exclusive-choice control — active option gets the same solid-ink treatment as a primary button, deliberately.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; border: 1px solid #dcd6cc; background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; padding: 3px; font-family: 'Onest', sans-serif; } .ds-seg-btn { background: none; border: 0; padding: 8px 15px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(17,17,16,.6); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-seg-on { background: #111110; color: #fff; }

components.name: Checklist Item
components.description: Signature component — animated pending-to-done checkmark; a fourth amber "never will be done" state exists to avoid confusion with pending.
components.html:
Реквизиты владельца
Cookie-политика
Отраслевой блок — не входит
components.css: .ds-cl-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e4dd; font-family: 'Onest', sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; color: rgba(17,17,16,.35); transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-cl-mark { flex: none; width: 19px; height: 19px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px dashed #dcd6cc; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: transparent; } .ds-cl-mark::before { content: '✓'; } .ds-cl-done { color: #111110; } .ds-cl-done .ds-cl-mark { border: none; background: rgba(26,122,82,.10); color: #1a7a52; animation: dsClPop 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); } @keyframes dsClPop { 0% { transform: scale(.3); } 55% { transform: scale(1.2); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } } .ds-cl-na { color: #b87900; } .ds-cl-na .ds-cl-mark { border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(184,121,0,.4); color: #b87900; } .ds-cl-na .ds-cl-mark::before { content: '–'; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Active state uses the same solid-ink/white-text language as a primary button and a selected segmented control.
components.html: ▤ Обзор
components.css: .ds-navlist { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; font-family: 'Onest', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item, .ds-nav-on { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 11px; border-radius: 9px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; background: none; border: 0; text-align: left; text-decoration: none; color: rgba(17,17,16,.68); transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #fff; color: #111110; } .ds-nav-on { background: #111110; color: #fff; }

narrative.overview: The system reads like a well-run notary's desk, not a startup dashboard: warm paper, precise black ink, and exactly one blue — reserved for the seal, not scattered across every button. Density is high and unapologetic (15px base text, 12–15px cards, tight 8–14px internal padding) because the audience is a business owner checking whether their paperwork is in order, not browsing a marketing site. Numbers that must be exact — domains, ИНН, ОГРН, dates, code — always switch to monospace, the same visual cue a stamped document uses to mark the parts that were typed in, not printed. Elevation is almost entirely absent by design: surfaces separate by a hairline border and a tonal step (desk → filed paper → fresh sheet), not by shadow. The two places a real shadow appears — the account dropdown and the mobile sticky action bar — are both transient overlays floating above the page, and nowhere else. Confirmed visual rejection: no gradients, no soft glassy blur, no colored button fills beyond the single blue accent's hover state — this is a compliance product, and the interface should look like it takes the law as seriously as it wants the client to.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, near-white paper canvas; near-black ink text; one rare blue accent
Flat by default — hairline borders and tonal layering instead of shadows
Monospace exclusively for domains, registry numbers, dates, codes, and money — never for prose
High density, generous corner radius (9–12px cards/buttons, full pill for chips/avatars/segmented controls)
Status communicated by a small closed set of semantic colors (green/red/amber), never by the brand blue

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Seal Blue is reserved for the logo mark, hover states, and focus rings only — primary buttons are Ink, not blue. If blue appears on more than one element per screen, that is drift.

rules.name: The Exact-Numbers-Go-Mono Rule
rules.body: Any domain, ИНН/ОГРН/ОГРНИП, bank detail, date, price, or code snippet renders in JetBrains Mono, full stop — even inline inside an otherwise Onest sentence.

rules.name: The Two-Chrome Rule
rules.body: A screen belongs to exactly one of the two containers (cabinet sidebar vs. narrow funnel flow), never a hybrid; step-numbering must stay continuous within its own chrome group.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: The only two shadows in the system lift something physically above the page (account dropdown, sticky mobile bar) — a card, button, or input never gets a shadow.

dos: Do put a domain, registry number, date, price, or code snippet in JetBrains Mono, every time, with no exceptions.
Do separate surfaces with a border and a tonal step (Desk → Filed Paper → Sheet); reach for a shadow only on something physically floating above the page.
Do use the same 'solid Ink, flips to white text' selected/active treatment across buttons, segmented controls, and nav.
Do keep a screen's step counter continuous within its own chrome container; a reset reads as a bug even when the container legitimately changed.
donts: Don't put Seal Blue on a primary button fill, a background, or anything decorative.
Don't add a shadow to a card, button, input, or any other in-flow surface.
Don't invent a fourth semantic color — green/red/amber is the closed set.
Don't round anything past the pill shape or leave a sharp corner anywhere.
